clue.text: Applauded striking shot

parts.note: applauded means clapped
workers on strike are out

explanation.surface: A crowd cheered a striking shot in some ball game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' looks like a noun in the sporting picture, but it is the slang adjective for worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British words for worn out and no longer working properly.

clue.text: Mention computing etc in church

indicators.note: in puts the computing letters inside the church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
IT, information technology, covers computing and the like

explanation.surface: Talk about computers in a church setting.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite something is to refer to or quote it.

clue.text: A box having a good American vegetable

parts.note: to spar is to box

explanation.surface: A crate holds a good vegetable from America.
explanation.definitionFit: Green spears eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Bloomer made by climber to hand over roping one in following further down

indicators.note: roping means lassoing, so the word encloses the one

parts.note: to pass on is to hand over
I is the Roman numeral one
lower means further down

explanation.surface: A climber passes something down while roping someone in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' is a flower here, not a blunder; the 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The blossom of the passion vine, a climbing plant.

clue.text: Clean vermin around the Italian home

parts.note: to do a room is to clean it

indicators.note: around means the vermin surround the article

parts.note: mice are vermin
il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: Clear rodents from around an Italian's house.
explanation.definitionFit: A domicile is a formal word for a residence.

clue.text: Extreme remark

definitions.meaning: complete, absolute, as in total nonsense

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means total or absolute; as a verb it means to speak.

clue.text: Tall pine

definitions.meaning: tall means of great height or length
to pine is to yearn for something

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the adjective for great length, the other the verb for yearning.

clue.text: I pen rearing antelope

indicators.note: rearing up suggests going upward in a down entry, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a biro is a ballpoint pen

explanation.surface: I fence in an antelope being raised.
explanation.definitionFit: A small African antelope.

clue.text: Ancient grassland giving vegetables protection

parts.note: greens are leafy vegetables
ward means guard or protection

explanation.surface: Old meadows shield vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic or literary word for a stretch of grassy turf.

clue.text: Server of refreshments in the form of Spanish snack selection

parts.note: a tap serves beer or water
as means in the role or form of

explanation.surface: A waiter carries round a selection of Spanish snacks.
explanation.definitionFit: Small savoury dishes served together in Spanish bars go by this name.

clue.text: Weather forecasters satisfied not wanting frosty conditions

parts.note: to satisfy a need is to meet it, past tense met
someone off their food is not wanting it
ice forms in frosty weather

explanation.surface: Forecasters are pleased that no frost is coming.
explanation.walkthrough: The Met Office is the UK's national weather service.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's national meteorological service produces the country's official weather forecasts.

clue.text: Cleaner that's got down to work

definitions.text: Cleaner that's got down to work

parts.words: Cleaner that's got down to work
parts.note: reads as a cleaner who has started work, but down means soft feathers, a tool that uses plumes to clean

explanation.definitionFit: A cleaning tool made of feathers on a stick for removing dust.

clue.text: Belief prevalent in Tibet or ancient Iran surprisingly

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A doctrine is said to be widespread in Tibet or old Persia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' rearranges the letters of OR ANCIENT IRAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebirth of the soul in a new body is a central tenet of Tibetan Buddhism.

clue.text: Book trade has short blip in advertising

indicators.note: in places the cut blip inside

parts.note: pushing a product is advertising it

indicators.note: short means the last letter is cut off

explanation.surface: The book business suffers a brief dip in promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: The industry that produces and sells books.

clue.text: Chap in high-class railway having expedition

parts.note: U is the old label for upper-class usage

indicators.note: in places the chap inside the railway abbreviation

parts.note: a gent is a chap

explanation.surface: A man travels on a posh train line on some journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Expedition' here means speed and promptness, not a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with expedition means acting with haste, done quickly and pressingly.

clue.text: Dog getting publicity in e.g. Crufts

indicators.note: in puts the publicity inside the event

parts.note: Crufts is a famous British dog show
an ad is publicity

explanation.surface: A dog gets attention at Crufts, Britain's famous dog show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog' is a verb meaning follow closely, not the animal of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To dog someone is to follow them closely, as a tail does.

clue.text: Return in car to make a point

definitions.meaning: to make a point forcefully understood

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a journey home by road; figuratively, to press an argument home.

clue.text: Highland lake's not so much without exclamation by Scots Nationalist

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside

parts.note: less means not so much
och is a Scottish exclamation

explanation.surface: A Scottish lake is smaller without a Scots Nationalist exclaiming.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of lake's is a link (is). 'without' means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous loch near Inverness, home of the legendary monster.

clue.text: Tally's assembled in the end

indicators.note: assembled says the letters are put together anew

parts.note: the word with its s read as letters

explanation.surface: A count is put together at the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembled' rearranges TALLYS; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean finally, at the conclusion of a sequence.

clue.text: One waiting for delivery man — about time

indicators.note: about means surrounding the time letter

parts.note: a courier delivers parcels

explanation.surface: Someone is waiting on a delivery driver who is late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One waiting' suggests a customer, but means an attendant at court, as in a lady-in-waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: Attendants at a royal court wait on the monarch.

clue.text: Computer company yielding venue for raves

parts.note: something yielding is soft
raves were often held in disused warehouses

explanation.surface: A tech firm gives in and offers a place for dance parties.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm that develops and sells programs is called this.

clue.text: Deadly army in Cornish river

indicators.note: in puts the army inside the river

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall, the county in south-west England
TA, the Territorial Army

explanation.surface: Soldiers are in danger in a river in Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a lethal wound or poison is one that kills.

clue.text: Road to ruin heading East

indicators.note: heading means the ruin goes in front of the compass point

parts.note: a rout is a crushing defeat or ruin

explanation.surface: A road leads to ruin as it goes east.
explanation.definitionFit: A way or course taken to get somewhere.

clue.text: Dull piece of scenery

definitions.meaning: a painted panel of stage set

explanation.definitionFit: It describes something lifeless, and is also the theatre term for a painted backdrop panel.

clue.text: Episode from lurid teen novel

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters take a new form

explanation.surface: A passage is taken from a sensational teenage book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' reads as a book but rearranges LURID TEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief intervening period or episode is an interval of this kind.

clue.text: Dwarf fish

definitions.meaning: a small ugly creature of Scandinavian folklore
to fish by trailing a line behind a boat

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a folklore goblin, the other a fishing method using a trailed baited line.

clue.text: Beat back game

indicators.note: back means the word is read the other way

parts.note: to flog is to beat

explanation.surface: Win a return match.
explanation.definitionFit: A sport played with clubs and a ball over a course of holes.

clue.text: Comfort king being swallowed by exhausted marine monster

indicators.note: being swallowed means taken inside the word for exhausted

parts.note: spent means exhausted
ease is comfort
R is the abbreviation for rex, king

explanation.surface: A tired sea creature gulps down a monarch, finding comfort in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A legendary giant snake-like creature of the oceans.
